description: Feature conditions bind constants from their selected stage, including later definitions.

documents.p.md:
```jbogenbau
%stage first
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text A
%emits
%stage second
%features f
%conditions $.classes ∩ $C ≠ ∅
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%const $C A
%rule text f? A

```
